# pleb

> Local, MIT-licensed, zero-telemetry web acquisition CLI and stdio MCP server (`pleb`) by Memory Sync Hub LLC, built to unblock `403`s and empty JS shells in Claude Code and Codex.

`pleb` wires into Claude Code and Codex via `pleb setup` (`pleb mcp`, bundled skill, and `WebFetch` hooks via `--hooks redirect|fallback|none`), fetches over Chromium 154 Cronet (or cookie-jar `reqwest`) with `CEF v5-meta` / WebSocket CDP escalation (`--render cdp`) and optional RFC 9421 signing (`pleb auth init-web-bot-auth`), and fails fast (exit `2`) on active bot challenges without CAPTCHA bypass.

## Primary Docs

- [skills/pleb/SKILL.md](skills/pleb/SKILL.md): Canonical version-locked agent skill embedded in `pleb skill print` / `pleb setup`
- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): Single-file technical reference, CLI flags, env vars, and JSON schemas for full-context agents
- [README-FULL.md](README-FULL.md): Complete human and integrator manual, architecture, benchmarks, and tool comparisons
- [README.md](README.md): Concise install, harness setup, and quick-start entry point

## Repo and Operations

- [Cargo.toml](Cargo.toml): Crate manifest (`pleb`, default `reqwest` with cookies, optional `--features cronet`)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Build rules, host binary sync, hermetic test isolation, and standing non-regression gates
- [data/site-rules.json](data/site-rules.json): Bundled host rewrites and mandatory CEF overrides
- [scripts/](scripts/): Cronet downloaders, CEF `v5-meta` installers, and skill install helper
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): MIT license and `wickproject/wick` attribution

## Optional

- [docs/](docs/): Historical Milestone 1–6 design records (`README-FULL.md`, `llms-full.txt`, `skills/pleb/SKILL.md`, and `src/` are authoritative)
